description: Calculate the correct position size given a maximum risk in USDT and a stop-loss price. Use when user asks "how many coins should I buy?" or "size my position so I risk exactly $X". Returns: positionSize (base), positionUsdt, marginRequired.

contractType.description: linear = USDT-margined (default), inverse = coin-margined. For inverse, sizeQuote is USD contracts and margin is returned in the base coin.

name: workflow.run_position_sizing
